title: ReorderPipelineStepsRequest
description: PUT /api/pipelines/:id/steps/order body (HEL-407). `stepIds` is the pipeline's step ids in their new relative order and must be exactly a permutation of the pipeline's current step ids (missing ids, unknown ids, or duplicates all fail with 422). On success every step's position is set to its index in `stepIds` within a single transaction.
